overall: Atlanta is already running warm this morning, with the temperature reaching 80.6°F by 11:50 ET — essentially matching the NWS-forecast daily high of ~81°F with several hours still to go. forecast_obs_notes: The NWP models are notably divergent: GFS (78.0°F), HRRR (77.9°F), and NBM (78.8°F) are already being beaten by observed conditions, while only ECMWF (82.0°F) correctly anticipated the current warmth. max_temp_prediction: With the running max already at 80.6°F at midday, a peak timing model pointing to ~15:30 ET, and still-positive warming velocity, today's TMAX will almost certainly land in the 81-83°F range barring an early storm that cuts off the afternoon heating. Confidence is moderate-high given the strong intraday anchor, but afternoon convection introduces meaningful downside uncertainty that keeps a sub-81°F outcome possible if storms arrive early.
